# 0.2.49: .47 belly laugh and tear-wipe with rocking and kicks

The user clarified that the 0.2.48 historical source-component laugh was not the requested base. This version restores the .47 painted smile, abdomen-holding hands, tears and two wiping strokes, then adds forward/backward waist rotation, alternating calf kicks and stronger unstable support sway. The .47 PNGs and 8.0-second tear/wipe timing remain unchanged. 0.2.48 and its sources/profile are preserved in the version cache before this edit.

The waist rocks by an additional 0.145 radians times a smoothly ramped oscillation. The support sways by sin(5.1t)*0.050+sin(11.7t)*0.010, and dips by -(3.0+sin(8.5t)*1.6). Both calf kicks use the original opposing phases and amplitudes 0.82/0.76, with the retained renderer projection scaling. The added motions ramp down between 4.2 and 4.95 seconds, before the .47 wiping hand rises at 5.0 seconds. A smaller support sway continues during wiping. Mouth, tears and wiping contact follow the final head transform.

Eye inspection revealed four pupils during the old portrait crossfade. The dedicated laugh PNG already has the correct two partially open eyes, whereas the normal eye patches occupy different coordinates. The laugh head and wipe palm now live in a separate opaque portrait root. A shared ownership predicate hides either the normal portrait or dedicated portrait at each frame, keeping a single opaque face. A rigid two-eye similarity registration aligns the dedicated eye line at the handoff and smoothly returns to the unchanged .47 head pose at full laugh weight. This leaves every painted face pixel unchanged and prevents double irises. Mouth and tears remain children of the same head; the wiping palm uses its final transformed angle/contact.

Validation: Release build, 41 core checks including preserved tears/wipe, opposing kicks and bidirectional torso lean; 1058 renderer timeline stages in both desk modes, 445 moved-layout/input isolation stages, full-blink collision and normal returns. Ten ordinary key/mouse/rest PNGs are RGBA-identical to the pre-edit normal render. Native installation and playback are recorded separately in the version cache. Global input authorization remains subject to the already-pending macOS Touch ID/password refresh.

`layered-rocking-v5-contract.json` pins the motion, rig, face constants and original .47 art and requires the single-portrait integration. Prior v3 and v4 contracts are retained as archived records.
